blurb: RapidHeli provides a variety of helicopter services in Salt Lake City including heavy external load and aerial surveillance, luxury executive charters, construction lifts, utility installations, and emergency rescue. They do not offer pre-packaged sightseeing tours but provide custom charters with a minimum of 1 hour. Their services include logistical planning, FAA compliance, and use of vetted subcontractors with appropriate certifications.
